name: HOURGLASS
desc:
Expect a few bugs at the moment, the game is still being improved and has a lot planned for the future.

You wake up in a strange place...
Grab that pistol and get going.
You are not alone, time is on your side.
Steal their weapons as you try to make your escape, there is no reloading after all...
Everything here is trying to kill you, make sure you show them hell.

DISCLAIMER:
THIS IS NOT A SUPER-HOT LIKE GAME WHERE TIME MOVES WHEN YOU MOVE. (For now at least)

Inspired by :

SUPERHOT - SUPERHOT Team
